SparkR / SPARKR-185
Exit SparkR Backend process when R exits
Issue Type: Bug
Assignee: Unassigned
Components: Internals
Created: 26/Jan/15 1:59 PM
Priority: Critical
Reporter: Shivaram Venkataraman

Right now the SparkRBackend process is terminated by sending a `stopBackend` RPC. However this doesn't always work as the R process might terminate early etc.
We should look at other ways to terminate the backend in case the R process exits
